tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool light grey, so white cards stand out. Also the sea on maps.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, tile and table surface. Land fill on maps.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Inset surfaces inside a card: image slots, chart tracks, neutral chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, figures. 15:1 on card.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: TL;DR body, legends, row values. 7.5:1 on card.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels, subtitles, axis text, captions. 4.6:1 on card. Flag: 4.2:1 on bg, below 4.5 for 12 px text (meta line, footer); use ink-2 there if this must pass.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Card borders, table row dividers, chart gridlines, map coastline stroke.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The one accent. The pick, the active tab, links, source references, positive status text. 4.8:1 on card. Flag: 4.2:1 on teal-soft (active tab, Verified chip); darken to pass.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: TL;DR highlight (mark), active tab fill, pick row in tables, 'verified' chip fill.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: No, fails, unverified, red-team text, negative values, trigger lines. Status only, never a category.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Red-team box and 'unverified' chip fill.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Partial, one source only, conditional. Status text on orange-soft. Flag: 4.4:1 on orange-soft, just below 4.5.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: 'Single source' and 'no end date' chip fill.

tokens.name: c-used
tokens.usage: Categorical mark 1 (dots, bars, lines). Not for text. 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: c-new
tokens.usage: Categorical mark 2. Not for text.

tokens.name: c-diy
tokens.usage: Categorical mark 3. Not for text.

tokens.name: c-pi
tokens.usage: Categorical mark 4. Not for text.

tokens.name: c-mute
tokens.usage: Unknown, no data, other. Dashed bars for unknown policy.

tokens.name: ann
tokens.usage: Design-review notes only. Never in a published report.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip internal gap, mark padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row gap inside lists, legend dot gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between option cards, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a panel, card inner padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above the tab bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding, space before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tab buttons, image slots, gap rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segmented tab bar, inner boxes (red-team, TL;DR marks use 4px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, chart panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, buttons, chart bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and the tab bar. Dark theme: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3).
